checklist.criterion: `strict: true` is set: The tsconfig.json baseline strict flag is enabled
Target/module suit Node 20 ESM: `target` and `module` are set to values that support native ESM on Node 20 (e.g. `es2022`/`nodenext` or equivalent)
At least two additional strictness flags beyond `strict` are enabled: e.g. `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`, `noImplicitReturns`, or `noFallthroughCasesInSwitch`
`rootDir`/`outDir` are set correctly: `rootDir` is `src` and `outDir` is `dist`
No strict check is disabled and notes file explains choices: No option sets `strict: false` or disables a default strict check, and `tsconfig-notes.md` explains each non-obvious option
